methodologyNotes: Covers complete inflatable stand-up paddle boards (iSUPs) sold to consumers at a published US MSRP, including all-around, touring, and hybrid shapes made from drop-stitch construction. Excludes rigid/hardboard SUPs, inflatable kayaks, and windsurf/wing boards. Price is typical US MSRP for the board (or full package where the board is only sold as a package) in USD; priceNote states which. Length, width, and thickness are the manufacturer's stated board dimensions in inches (decimal; e.g. 10'6" is 126). volumeLiters is the board's stated volume in liters; null if not disclosed. maxCapacityLbs is the manufacturer's maximum rider/gear weight capacity in pounds. boardWeightLbs is the bare board weight (no accessories) in pounds. maxPressurePsi is the manufacturer's maximum recommended inflation pressure in PSI. finConfiguration is an enum: 'single', '2+1', '3-fin', or 'quad', describing the stock fin layout. finAttachment is an enum for the center-fin mount: 'us-box', 'click-fit', 'snap-lock', or 'slide-in'. constructionType is an enum for the drop-stitch/rail build: 'single-layer', 'dual-layer', 'fusion', or 'woven-dropstitch'. warrantyYears is the manufacturer's stated board warranty in years; null if not published.

products.name: Red Paddle Co Ride 10'6"
products.priceNote: US MSRP $949.00 for the 10'6" Ride MSL "No Paddle" package (board, twin iFins, ATB Transformer bag, Titan II pump, repair kit, phone case) per Red Equipment USA (red-equipment.us); the board is sold only as a package. Retailer Green Water Sports lists the same board from $945.00.
products.provenance: The Red Equipment USA manufacturer page confirms this is the "10'6" Ride MSL Inflatable Paddle Board Package" and states width (32"/813mm), thickness (4.7"/120mm), board weight (11.1kg/21.89lb), 220lb max weight, twin iFins, MSL laminate construction, a 5-year warranty, and a $949.00 "No Paddle" package price (the board is sold only as a package). Green Water Sports (retailer) corroborates the exact same model ("Red Paddle Co 10'6" x 32" Ride"), adding the 245-liter volume, 10'6" length, 220lb max rider weight, the 16-22psi recommended inflation range, the "MSL fusion composite" construction, and the 5-year (with-registration) warranty, listing it from $945.00. Both pages describe the identical board — not the 10'8" Ride or 9'6" Compact — confirming model identity.

products.name: iRocker All-Around 11'
products.priceNote: US full-package MSRP. iROCKER is sold only as a complete package. The official 8.0 product page (source) shows the ALL AROUND 11' 8.0 package buy box as "$529 $799" — i.e. a regular/compare-at price of $799 (used here as priceUsd) currently discounted to $529. An on-page comparison module additionally lists "Price $649" for this board. All three figures ($799, $529, $649) appear verbatim on the fetched manufacturer page.
products.provenance: The official iROCKER 8.0 product page confirms the ALL AROUND 11' as an 11' x 32" x 6" board rated to 400 lb capacity, built with triple-layer PVC composite over a traditional (knitted) drop-stitch core, shipping with three tethered fins and rated to 15-16 PSI, at a $799 regular package price (sale $529). The hands-on InflatableBoarder review of the ALL AROUND 11' 7.0 corroborates identical 11'/32"/6" dimensions, 400 lb capacity, 16 PSI max recommended pressure, a 26 lb bare board weight, a 3-year board warranty, and a 9" center + two 4.5" side-fin (2+1) layout. Model identity verified: this is iROCKER's current "All-Around 11'" (sold as 8.0 on the manufacturer store); the reviewed 7.0 is the same board line with the same dimensions, capacity, and construction — not the Cruiser, All-Around 10', or Ultra variant. finAttachment left null because iROCKER's proprietary "flip-lock" fin box matches none of the enum values; volumeLiters null because iROCKER does not publish board volume.

products.name: Gili Meno 11'6"
products.priceNote: InflatableBoarder's 2025 "Gili Sports 11'6\" Meno" review specification table lists "List Price $960.00". The Meno is sold only as a complete package (board, carbon/nylon 3-piece paddle, triple-action hand pump, fin set, leash, repair kit, wheeled bag), so per methodology this is the full-package US list price.
products.provenance: The official manufacturer page (gilisports.com/products/meno-inflatable-stand-up-paddle-board) returned HTTP 402 and could not be fetched, so specs were verified against two independent, dated reviews of this exact model. InflatableBoarder's 2025 "Gili Sports 11'6\" Meno" review provided a specification table confirming 11'6" x 35" x 6", 485 lb max capacity, 24 lb board weight, 2-year warranty, a "maximum 18psi" inflation pressure, "dual-layer fusion PVC" construction, and "List Price $960.00" for the complete kit. SUPBoardGuide's 2023 11'6" Meno review independently corroborated the same 11'6 x 35 x 6 dimensions, 24 lb weight, 485 lb capacity, "max PSI of 18", "dual layer PVC that is fusion laminated", and 2-year warranty. Both reviews explicitly distinguish the 11'6" from its 10'6" and 12'6" siblings (InflatableBoarder even includes a "difference between the Meno 11'6 and 10'6" FAQ), confirming model identity; the center fin is a 2+1 setup (one center box plus two 4.5" side bites), volume is not disclosed, and the center-fin mount is described only as "flip-lock" which maps to none of the finAttachment enum values, so both are null.

products.name: Bote Wulf Aero
products.priceNote: US MSRP $579.00 per manufacturer boteboard.com ("Regular price $579.00" / "Sale price $579.00", "0% OFF") for the WULF Aero standard kit (board + 3-piece adjustable aluminum paddle + coiled leash + 10" click-in Aero center fin + repair kit + hand pump + fabric backpack). The board is sold only as this kit, so the figure is the kit MSRP; a separate premium "package" exists at a higher price. A 2025 InflatableBoarder review's cleaned page did not expose a numeric list price, and a search snippet cited a ~$499 historical figure, so I used the current manufacturer MSRP.
products.provenance: The BOTE manufacturer page confirms this is the WULF Aero inflatable paddle board and lists "Regular price $579.00" for the standard kit; its Technical Specs give the base 10'4" configuration as 10'4" L x 34" W x 6" D, 250 LBS capacity, 20 LBS avg board weight, 10-15 PSI optimal inflation, AeroULTRA construction, and a 2-Year Warranty, with one 10" "Click-in Aero Center Fin" (mapped to click-fit). The InflatableBoarder hands-on review corroborates the identical 10'4" model (Length 10'4", Width 34", Thickness 6", Max Capacity 250 pounds, Board Weight 20 pounds, Warranty 2 years) and adds two enum-critical facts the manufacturer states only in marketing terms: the build is "single-layer PVC" (constructionType single-layer, vs the manufacturer's "AeroULTRA" name) and the stock fin layout is 2+1 (fixed side fins plus a removable center fin). lengthInches 124 = 10'4" per the methodology's feet-inches-to-decimal rule; the Wulf Aero is also sold in an up-sized 11'4"/315 LBS/22 LBS version, and this entry represents the base 10'4" configuration that both sources document; the review loosely called the center-fin mount a "slide-in fin box" but I deferred to the manufacturer's explicit "Click-in" and a customer review's description of a switch/click mechanism; volume is not disclosed on either page, so volumeLiters is null.
